notes: Needs ruling (rule 11, implicit transmission): «قال ثم لقيته بعد فسألته فقال» (two later sayings of Shu'ba) names no transmitter but a pronoun «لقيته», so they are not written; only the first saying (Sayyar, his father, Abu Barza) is stored.
The father is a bare relation («سمعت أبي يسأل أبا برزة»): the one asked, Abu Barza, answers and is the last link.
